title: Item levels
changes: Gear now has an item level (1 to 30): drops and chests match the monster or chest level, and higher levels give bigger bonuses.
Wearing gear needs a hero level and points in one stat (Strength, Magic, Stamina or Dexterity). Hover an item in the Bag (G) to see it.
High-level gear shows on your hero: sparkles from Lv 8, swing trails and spark steps from Lv 15, flames and auras from Lv 22, and a finishing shockwave with afterimages from Lv 28.
